title: S&P Global projects 7% growth for India through 2028
summary: In its Economic Outlook Asia-Pacific Q1 2027 report, S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI) projects that India will grow at 7% this fiscal year and again in the year to March 2028, a pace that would rank the country among the fastest-expanding economies in the Asia-Pacific region in 2027. According to the outlook, robust expansion will be accompanied by price pressures that refuse to ease.

title: S&P upgrades E.W. Scripps to ‘B-’ on cost cuts and debt reduction progress
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded E. W. Scripps Co (NASDAQ:SSP) issuer credit rating to ‘B-’ from ‘CCC+’ with a stable outlook, signaling growing confidence in the broadcaster’s ability to sustain positive free operating cash flow through a full political cycle. The ratings agency also lifted issue-level ratings across the company's debt stack, including raising its first-lien senior secured debt to ‘B+’ from ‘B’ and its second-lien senior secured debt to ‘B-’ from ‘CCC+’.

title: S&P joins Fitch in downgrading Turkish white goods maker Arcelik on “ongoing challenges”
summary: S&P Global Ratings has moved to downgrade Turkish white goods producer Arcelik (Istanbul/ARCLK) by one notch to B, five notches below investment grade, citing ongoing business challenges delaying deleveraging prospects, according to a statement released by the international rating agency. The assigned outlook, meanwhile, remains negative.

S&P downgrades Flowers Foods to ‘BB’ on earnings pressure and covenant risks
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings lowered its issuer credit rating on Flowers Foods Inc (NYSE:FLO) to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ on Nov. 23, 2026, assigning a negative outlook as persistent demand headwinds and elevated input costs weigh on profitability. The agency also downgraded the packaged bakery company's senior unsecured notes to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ with a ‘3’ recovery rating, signaling an expected recovery of 50% to 70% in a default scenario.
